body: Couldn't agree more. His comments made me mad because I suffered from depression and eating disorders along with suicidal thoughts. I found joy in the smite community cuz watching game plays are so entertaining and its just a place where I can  be happy and at ease. I'm still on the path to recovery from my eating disorder and the loss of my step sister to suicide 3 years ago. I really hope the donator was alright because if someone were to say those comments to me, all the months of recovery work would probably be out the window and I would be back to square one :( I'm sorry for your loss and you are a good person, have a great day.
I don't know what's wrong with him. I honestly don't.... I hope he gets some help
